judged_text: Admin::EmbeddingController#update never reads params or mutates @embedding; it re-renders the fetch_embedding snapshot unchanged, so the PUT /admin/customize/embedding endpoint the frontend's saveChanges action calls is a silent no-op. An admin who changes embedding-level settings and clicks save gets a success response while nothing is persisted; combined with the client controller sending update({}), the update route exists purely to satisfy the adapter and stores no data.

adjudication.rationale: In the diff, Admin::EmbeddingController#update simply re-renders the fetched OpenStruct (@embedding) and never reads params or persists anything (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb). The client controller does define a saveChanges action that calls this.get('embedding').update({}) (app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6), so if invoked it would indeed be a no-op PUT. However, the provided template (app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs) has no save button or binding for embedding-level settings, and host CRUD is handled via Admin::EmbeddableHostsController, so the claim about admins changing embedding-level settings and clicking save isn’t directly supported by this diff.
